caveats: Sequential processes; OS file cache not purged. Five English/code pairs per final process; report each training pair separately.
37 useful decode tokens per pair; first output token belongs to prefill. Short repeated corpus does not establish long or changing-topic performance.
File bytes count native source reads and can hit Windows cache; physical SSD traffic and page residency were not measured.
Requested cap is live matrix upper bound, reduced by global guard; arena backing includes unused slots and class padding.
Check foreign_engine_monitor for overlapping external engine activity before treating a run as a speed comparison.
The first arena and control runs overlapped other MiMo GPU fixtures during startup/first requests. Both are retained, not used for the final speed claim.
This engine accounted only live matrices in the cache budget. Repeated trimming could leave up to6.347 GiB idle inside still-resident blocks. The later engine accounts arena backing.
